edit.old: Stopping a whole paper and stopping only its print edition are different events.
edit.new: Stopping a whole paper and stopping only its print edition are different events. A repeated habitual verb with a different object (publishing the paper vs. publishing its online edition) is not `:same-event`. Never use `:same-entity` between events.
